title: South Carolina Code of Laws Title 58, Chapter 27 - Electric Utilities and Electric Cooperatives
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 58 chapter index (https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/title58.php): title 'Title 58 - Public Utilities, Services and Carriers', chapter row 'CHAPTER 27 - ELECTRIC UTILITIES AND ELECTRIC COOPERATIVES' with no [REPEALED] marker; then fetched https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/t58c027.php, whose heading reads 'CHAPTER 27 / Electric Utilities and Electric Cooperatives', with Article 7 (Rates and Charges), Article 9 (Extension and Abandonment of Service) and Article 11 (Adequacy of Service, Reports, Accounts, and the Like), running from SECTION 58-27-10 to SECTION 58-27-2810. Currency: current through the 2025 Session.
notes: Chosen because electricity is the near-universal household utility and this chapter carries the rates-and-charges and adequacy-of-service duties. A human may prefer Title 58, Chapter 5 (Gas, Heat, Water, Sewerage Collection and Disposal, and Street Railway Companies), also verified in force, which carries Article 3 (Regulation of Rates and Services Generally) and, squarely on billing, Article 11 (Termination of Natural Gas Service Due to Nonpayment). Much of the operative billing, deposit and disconnection detail for all utilities sits in Public Service Commission regulations rather than in the Code.
